name: markhor
draw: Markhor head with tall corkscrew horns twisting upward and a long flowing beard.

name: bighorn-sheep
draw: Bighorn sheep head in profile with massive horns curling around in a full circle beside the face.

name: barbary-sheep
draw: Barbary sheep in side view with long fringe hair hanging from throat and front legs and backward curved horns.

name: jacob-sheep
draw: Jacob sheep head with four horns, two curving up and two curling down beside the face.

name: racka-sheep
draw: Racka sheep head with long straight horns twisted like corkscrews spiraling upward in a V.

name: nubian-goat
draw: Nubian goat head with a convex Roman nose and very long wide drooping ears.

name: angora-goat
draw: Angora goat in side view covered in long curly ringlets of mohair with backward curved horns.

name: moose
draw: Moose head with wide flat palm-shaped antlers, a long drooping nose and a dewlap bell under the chin.

name: musk-deer
draw: Musk deer head with no antlers and two long thin fangs hanging down from the upper jaw.

name: fallow-deer
draw: Fallow deer in side view with a spotted coat and broad flat palmate antlers.

name: woolly-mammoth
draw: Woolly mammoth in side view with a high domed head, a sloping back, shaggy hair and long curved tusks.

name: woolly-rhinoceros
draw: Woolly rhinoceros in side view with a shaggy coat and a very long curved front horn.

name: giant-ground-sloth
draw: Giant ground sloth standing upright on its hind legs with its tail as a prop and large curved claws.

name: glyptodon
draw: Glyptodon in side view with a large domed patterned shell like a giant armadillo and a spiked tail.

name: irish-elk
draw: Irish elk in side view with gigantic wide flat antlers spanning wider than its body.

name: deinotherium
draw: Deinotherium in side view, an elephant-like animal with tusks curving down and back from the lower jaw.

name: platybelodon
draw: Platybelodon head with a long flat shovel-like lower jaw tipped with wide flat tusks.

name: paraceratherium
draw: Paraceratherium in side view, a giant hornless rhino relative with a long neck and long legs.

name: macrauchenia
draw: Macrauchenia in side view with a camel-like long neck and body and a short trunk on its snout.

name: basilosaurus
draw: Basilosaurus, an early whale, in side view with a very long serpent-like body and toothy jaws.

name: entelodont
draw: Entelodont in side view, a hog-like animal with a huge long head, bony jaw knobs and long legs.

name: sivatherium
draw: Sivatherium head, a stocky giraffe relative with broad palmate ossicones like moose antlers.

name: hoof-print
draw: Pair of cloven hoof prints side by side, two teardrop halves with a gap between them.

name: bear-track
draw: Bear footprint with a wide kidney-shaped pad and five toe pads topped by claw marks.

name: claw-marks
draw: Three parallel curved scratch marks slashed diagonally, as left by an animal claw.

name: cattle-skull
draw: Front view cattle skull with a long face, empty eye sockets and wide curved horns.

name: quagga
draw: Quagga, the extinct zebra, in side view with stripes only on the head, neck and shoulders and a plain rear body.

name: arsinoitherium
draw: Arsinoitherium head in profile, a prehistoric rhino-like animal with two huge conical horns side by side on the nose.

name: uintatherium
draw: Uintatherium head in profile with three pairs of knobby bony horns on the skull and long saber upper fangs.

name: gomphotherium
draw: Gomphotherium in side view, an early elephant relative with two tusks on the upper jaw and two on the long lower jaw.
